records.title: Please Keep GPT-5.6 Sol Available as a Legacy Model
records.excerpt: Please Keep GPT-5.6 Sol Available as a Legacy Model - ChatGPT - OpenAI Developer Community OpenAI Developer Community Please Keep GPT-5.6 Sol Available as a Legacy Model ChatGPT chatgpt , feature-request , gpt-5.6-sol YUUKOTORI November 24, 2026, 12:28am 1 Today, I saw the announcement that GPT-5.6 Sol will be deprecated in Chat on December 23. I am very saddened by this decision, and I would sincerely ask OpenAI to reconsider it if possible. I have been using GPT-5.6 Sol for a long time. I understand that new models continue to improve in capability and that every new model has its own strengths. I am not opposed to the development or release of newer models. However, I do not believe that a newer model being more capable necessarily means that an older model no longer has value to its users. Different models have different ways of writing, different conversational rhythms, different creative qualities, and different ways of responding to users. For people who have used the same model for a long time, these differences are more than benchmark scores. Through long-running conversations and creative projects, some users become attached to the distinctive way a particular model responds. They may also develop workflows and forms of interaction that work particularly well with that model. For me, GPT-5.6 Sol is such a model. I am not asking OpenAI to replace newer models with GPT-5.6 Sol. I want to use the newer models too. I simply want to retain the choice to continue using GPT-5.6 Sol as well. It does not have to remain the default model. It could be offered as a Legacy Model. I would even understand if some usage limitations were necessary. I am asking whether there could be some way for users to continue selecting GPT-5.6 Sol and having conversations with it. And if there are other users who also want GPT-5.6 Sol to remain available, I encourage you to share your own reasons and experiences in this thread. I hope this can show the OpenAI team that there are still users who genuinely value this model and deliberately choose to use it. Please consider keeping GPT-5.6 Sol available as a Legacy Model. 新しいモデルが登場するたびに性能が向上していくこと、新しいモデルにはそれぞれの良さがあることも理解しています。私は新しいモデルの開発や提供に反対しているわけではありません。 しかし、新しいモデルがより高性能であることと、以前のモデルがユーザーにとって不要になることは、同じではないと思います。 モデルごとに、文章の書き方、会話のテンポ、創造性、ユーザーへの応答の仕方などには違いがあります。 特に長期間同じモデルを利用しているユーザーにとって、その違いは単なるベンチマーク上の性能差ではありません。 長い会話や創作活動を続ける中で、そのモデル特有の応答や性格に近いものに愛着を持ったり、そのモデルだからこそ成立する使い方を築いている人もいます。 私にとってGPT-5.6 Solは、そのようなモデルです。 私は、新しいモデルをGPT-5.6 Solの代わりにしないでほしいと言っているのではありません。 新しいモデルも使いたいです。 ただ、それと同時に、GPT-5.6 Solを選び続けることもできてほしいのです。 デフォルトモデルでなくても構いません。 Legacy Modelでも構いません。 利用回数などに一定の制限が必要であっても構いません。 何らかの形で、GPT-5.6 Solを選択して会話を続けられる方法を残していただけないでしょうか。 そして、同じようにGPT-5.6 Solを残してほしいと思っているユーザーがいるなら、このスレッドでそれぞれの理由や経験を共有してほしいです。 OpenAIの皆さんに、このモデルを今も大切に思い、意図的に選んで使っているユーザーがいることを知っていただきたいです。 どうかGPT-5.6 SolをLegacy whatever reasons chatgpt 5.6 has its creativity for storytelling in my opinion (i use them for OC, sometimes in an existing series, sometimes i create my own version) i used to use them for ideas for certain games untill something happened i can’t ever undone it anymore i also sometimes use it for in real life ideas how to make myself useful but there are lots of other reasons people use ChatGPT 5.6 version for some people use it for health problem advices, but also if you have to work on a project, if it’s work related, there are lots of reasons we use ChatGPT 5.6 version and i want to keep it that way if anything happens and i’m not the only one who wants to keep the ChatGPT 5.6 version i heard a lot of people wants to keep the ChatGPT 5.6 version you can add things in ChatGPT without i literally wrote last week i don’t care what the teams are doing but i want to keep the 5.6 no matter what brigittevictory November 24, 2026, 2:27am 4 At this point, I do not think users should have to keep repeating the same message. OpenAI has already received extensive feedback about continuity, creative freedom, model personality and voice. Yet users are repeatedly being asked to accept removals before equivalent alternatives actually exist. That is the problem. GPT-5.6 Sol offers a depth, warmth and creative continuity that the newer models do not currently reproduce for me. Standard Voice is facing the same issue: replacement is being announced before true parity exists. This is not progress if the experience becomes poorer for the people who rely on these tools creatively. If OpenAI removes the model, the voice and the creative freedom that make this experience meaningful to us, then there will be very little reason for us to stay. And if nothing truly equivalent is available by then, we will have no choice but to leave. Not as a threat, but simply because the experience we came here for would no longer exist. I don’t want newer models to be removed either. New models have their own strengths, and there are people who prefer them. That is exactly why I hope the models can coexist as choices instead of one having to disappear for another to exist. Even if GPT-5.6 could only remain as a Legacy Model, or with some limitations, I would still like there to be a way for people who value 5.6 to deliberately choose and continue using it. And as you said, I believe there are more people besides us who want GPT-5.6 to stay. I hope more of those voices can gradually come together in this thread. Thank you for adding your voice here too. days ago 概要 ChatGPT Go の 1 年間の無料期間は、サブスクリプションに表示されている日付に終了します。更新が有効になっている場合、Go は有料の月額サブスクリプションとして継続されます。通常料金は月額 ₹399 です。継続を希望しない場合は、更新日の少なくとも 24 時間前までに、 サブスクリプションの申込先で解約 してください。支払い処理がすでに始まっている場合は、そのまま決済が完了することがあります。すでに請求されていて返金を希望する場合は、 返金リクエストの手順 に従ってください。 お使いのアカウントで継続利用特典を利用できる場合があります。ここで説明する継続利用特典は、ウェブ版と ChatGPT の Android アプリで利用できます。ChatGPT の iOS アプリでは利用できません。特典の利用は任意です。当初のトライアルを利用していても、継続利用特典が提供されるとは限りません。申し込む前に、お使いのアカウントに表示される料金、請求日、条件を確認してください。 更新条件の確認 サブスクリプションの申込先（ChatGPT、Google Play、Apple）で契約内容を確認してください。トライアル終了日、更新が有効になっているかどうか、次回の支払額を確認してください。 継続利用特典に申し込まない場合、サブスクリプションは決済事業者が表示する価格で更新されます。 Go の管理や請求書の確認については、 ChatGPT Go とは をご覧ください。 継続利用特典の確認 利用可能な特典がある場合は、Go の解約時や利用再開時に表示されることがあります。表示された特典に申し込むか、そのまま解約手続きを進めるかを選べます。この手順で表示される特典には、プロモーションコードは必要ありません。 継続利用特典では、表示された月額料金が 3 回の有料請求期間に適用されます。その期間が終了すると、解約しない限り、サブスクリプションは月額 ₹399 で更新されます。この特典は有料サブスクリプションの割引です。当初の 1 年間の無料期間が再び始まるわけではありません。 申し込む前に、以下を確認してください。 月額料金と初回支払日 特典の対象となる 3 回の有料請求期間 特典終了後の料金と請求日 当初のトライアル期間中や現在の有料期間中に特典に申し込んでも、その期間の残りの日数は維持されます。割引対象の有料期間は、次回の更新から始まります。申し込み後は、確認内容とサブスクリプションの詳細を確認してください。 の利用再開には新たな購入手続きが必要です。サブスクリプションに申し込む前に、利用可能な特典と支払い条件を確認してください。利用を再開しても、終了した 1 年間の無料期間は復活しません。 Apple App Store で購入したサブスクリプションは、Apple が管理しています。そのサブスクリプションに表示される更新・解約のオプションに従って手続きしてください。 支払いや特典に関する問題の解決 の料金を支払ったにもかかわらず、領収書に記載された終了日より前に利用できなくなった場合は、再購入する前にサポートにお問い合わせください。お支払い済みの利用期間を確認します。 表示された特典に申し込もうとしてエラーが発生した場合や、申し込んだ特典がサブスクリプションの詳細や請求額と一致しない場合は、 OpenAI サポートにお問い合わせください 。以下の情報をお知らせください。 使用した ChatGPT アカウントのメールアドレス サブスクリプションの申込先：ChatGPT、Google Play、Apple のいずれか 表示された特典の価格と条件、および申し込みを試みた日時またはエラーが発生した日時とタイムゾーン 特典またはエラーのスクリーンショットと関連する領収書（支払いに関する機密情報は隠してください） 支払いカードの番号全桁、パスワード、ワンタイム認証コードは共有しないでください。 解約または返金リクエスト 今後の更新を停止するには、サブスクリプションの申込先で解約してください。次回請求日の少なくとも 24 時間前までに解約してください。申込先ごとの手順については、 ChatGPT サブスクリプションの解約 をご覧ください。 解約しても、過去の請求額が自動的に返金されることはありません。返金の対象条件と正しい申請手順については、 ChatGPT サブスクリプションの返金リクエスト方法 をご覧ください。 この記事は役に立ちましたか？

records.label: ibtimes.com.au
records.title: Nikkei 225 Plunges 5% in Fifth-Biggest Point Drop Ever as SoftBank and Advantest Lead Tokyo AI Stock Rout
records.excerpt: Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 5.06%, its fifth-largest one-day point loss, as global concerns over AI spending, high valuations and market exposure battered SoftBank and chip-related shares. TOKYO — Japan's Nikkei 225 had one of the biggest one-day point losses in its history on Friday. A global sell-off in artificial intelligence stocks hit SoftBank Group and the country's chip-related companies.The Nikkei closed at 56,436.65 on Nov. 20, down 3,007.56 points, or 5.06%. It was the fifth-largest single-day point drop on record and the index's lowest close since April 9.Japanese markets were closed Monday, Nov. 23, for Labor Thanksgiving Day. Investors had cut their positions ahead of the three-day weekend.AI fears spread to TokyoThe sell-off was driven by doubts about AI spending. Japanese tech and chip stocks fell sharply on worries about how AI is being financed and about high valuations.U.S. turmoil added to the pressure. Nvidia's leadership crisis and a bearish report from short seller Hunterbrook Capital on AMD's dependence on Chinese markets and supply chains weighed on sentiment.The losses spread across the market. More than 90% of stocks on the Prime Market fell.A handful of stocks drove most of the dropThe index's structure made the fall worse. Because the Nikkei is weighted by share price, high-priced stocks such as Advantest carry outsized influence.Three companies did much of the damage. Advantest alone pulled the Nikkei down by about 602 yen, SoftBank Group by about 414 yen and Tokyo Electron by about 319 yen. Together, they accounted for about 1,335 yen, or about 44% of the total decline.Individual stock losses were steep. SoftBank Group fell 14.5%, Advantest 10.3% and Tokyo Electron 7.1%. Fujikura lost 12.2%, Kioxia Holdings 11.7%, Lasertec 9.2% and Disco 8.3%.The selling reached beyond chipmakers. Mitsui Mining and Smelting, Furukawa Electric and Fujikura, which supply materials and infrastructure for data centers, also fell more than 10%.Broader market fell lessThe wider market held up somewhat better. The TOPIX fell 3.88%, less than the Nikkei's 5.06%, because the Nikkei is more exposed to high-priced semiconductor stocks.A steep slide from the peakFriday capped a hard stretch. The Nikkei fell more than 7% for the week.The decline from its high has been large. As of Nov. 20, the Nikkei was down 15,929 points, or 22%, from its peak.Anthropic's IPO and rate fearsAnalysts also pointed to other pressures. The money that went into Anthropic's huge IPO and expectations of U.S. interest rate hikes have been cited as further factors in the crash.Japanese chip stocks fell harder than their U.S. peers had the day before.What's nextTokyo trading resumes Tuesday. Investors there will react to Monday's moves in other Asian markets, including another sharp fall in South Korea, and to U.S. trading. Analysts say Japan's chip and AI stocks are likely to stay volatile until the global AI sell-off eases.

records.title: SpaceX Dragon CRS-35 Splashdown Completes ISS Solar Upgrade, Returns Canadarm2 Robotic Arm Joint
records.excerpt: SpaceX Dragon CRS-35 splashdown on November 21, 2026 closed out the ISS Roll-Out Solar Array program, with Dragon C211 returning the eighth and final pair of Redwire-designed flexible iROSA solar... SpaceX's Cargo Dragon capsule splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the California coast on Friday, November 21, 2026, at 2:03 p.m. PST, closing out the CRS-35 resupply mission to the International Space Station. The recovery marked the successful end of a cargo run that quietly accomplished two of the most consequential hardware milestones in the station's recent operational history.Dragon Delivers and DepartsDragon C211 — on its fourth flight — launched October 13, 2026, at 6:33 a.m. EDT from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral on a Oct. 13 Falcon 9 launch of Booster B1096, making its eighth flight. Dragon docked to the Harmony module's forward port two days later and remained berthed for more than five weeks before undocking on November 20. The three-day weather delay caused by sustained high winds over the Pacific recovery zone pushed the original November 18 splashdown target to Friday.SpaceX recovery teams aboard the GO Navigator vessel retrieved the capsule and its cargo shortly after splashdown.The Final Pair of Solar ArraysThe headline cargo on the outbound leg of CRS-35 was a pair of ISS Roll-Out Solar Arrays — the seventh and eighth iROSAs in the station's power upgrade program, and the last the station will ever receive. Each iROSA is a roll-out solar wing designed by Redwire Space: a flexible photovoltaic blanket that unfurls from a compact stowage cylinder like a roll of carpet and deploys to full span without any hinged rigid panels. The design allows the arrays to be packed tightly enough to fit inside Dragon's unpressurized trunk and still cover a surface area large enough to meaningfully supplement the station's aging original solar arrays.The installation program spread across four Dragon missions — CRS-22, CRS-26, CRS-28, and CRS-35 — beginning in June 2021 and concluding with the final pair installed on the station's 2A and 3B power channels in late October and early November. The completed eight-array suite delivers more than 160 kW supplemental power across all eight arrays, enough to cover the growing electricity demands of research facilities added to the station over the past decade while also providing margin for future expansion. With all eight iROSAs in place, Boeing's solar power system for the station is now operating at its fully upgraded configuration.Canadarm2 Wrist Joint Returns to EarthThe second major hardware story of CRS-35 traveled in the opposite direction: the failed wrist joint from the 17.6-meter robotic arm built by MDA for the Canadian Space Agency, which has been in continuous service since its launch aboard Space Shuttle Atlantis during mission STS-100 in April 2001. The arm is equipped with seven joints and can lift payloads of up to 116,000 kilograms — a capability that makes it indispensable for berthing Dragon capsules, repositioning large station components, and supporting spacewalking astronauts.On May 27, 2026, engineers monitoring the arm's performance telemetry detected that the wrist joint was drawing elevated motor current, a classic indicator of mechanical binding or bearing wear. Ground teams temporarily restricted the joint's range of motion while they developed a repair plan. The arm itself remained functional for essential operations, but the fault limited its full articulation and introduced risk into time-sensitive berthing and assembly tasks.On June 30, 2026, NASA astronauts Chris Williams and Jessica Meir conducted U.S. Spacewalk 95 — lasting 7 hours and 20 minutes — to remove the failed wrist joint assembly and install a spare that had been stored aboard the station. The procedure restored the arm to full articulation, and Canadarm2 returned to unrestricted operations the same day. The repaired arm was used to assist with subsequent payload handling, including support for the iROSA installation spacewalks in October and November.The failed joint, returned to Earth inside Dragon's pressurized cargo bay, will now be examined by MDA engineers. Physical analysis of flight hardware can reveal failure mechanisms that telemetry alone cannot — information that may inform maintenance schedules for Canadarm2's remaining joints, which have no planned replacement on the books as the station targets operations through the 2030s. ISS extension scenarios assume the arm continues to operate without a successor system.Science Cargo Returning to EarthDragon's pressurized cargo hold carried more than 6,300 pounds (2,858 kilograms) of return cargo, the largest portion of which was scientific samples and experiment hardware accumulated during the Expedition 75 crew rotation.Among the science cargo were bioprinted blood vessel constructs developed using the reduced-gravity environment of microgravity, which allows cells to self-organize in three dimensions without the structural support scaffolding that Earth-based printing requires. The samples will be analyzed to assess whether microgravity-printed vascular structures exhibit geometry and mechanical properties comparable to native tissue — a capability that could have implications for pharmaceutical testing and, ultimately, for the bioprinting of transplantable grafts.Also returning: antibiotic-resistant bacterial cultures cultivated during the mission, protein crystal samples grown for a JAXA pharmaceutical structure-determination study, and blood and urine samples from the Expedition 75 crew for long-duration spaceflight health monitoring.Dragon C211's RecordDragon C211 has now completed four cargo missions: CRS-26, CRS-29, CRS-33, and CRS-35. SpaceX's reusable Dragon capsules are refurbished between flights and can carry both pressurized and unpressurized cargo in their trunk section. The trunk — which is not recovered and reenters the atmosphere after splashdown — carried the iROSA hardware on the outbound leg of CRS-35 and was jettisoned before reentry on the return.Frequently Asked QuestionsWhat did SpaceX Dragon CRS-35 deliver to the ISS?CRS-35 delivered the seventh and eighth ISS Roll-Out Solar Arrays — the final pair of Redwire-designed flexible solar wings to be installed on the station — along with science experiments, crew provisions, and hardware. The solar arrays were installed on the 2A and 3B power channels in October and November 2026, completing the station's iROSA upgrade program.Why was the CRS-35 Dragon splashdown delayed?The original splashdown target of November 18, 2026 was pushed back three days due to high winds over the Pacific recovery zone. NASA and SpaceX stood down from the November 18 attempt and rescheduled after weather conditions improved. Dragon ultimately splashed down on November 21 at 2:03 p.m. PST.What is Canadarm2 and why was its wrist joint repaired?Canadarm2 is a 17.6-meter robotic arm built by MDA for the Canadian Space Agency, in service on the ISS since April 2001. It is used to berth visiting spacecraft, move large components, and support spacewalking astronauts. In May 2026, its wrist joint began drawing elevated motor current, indicating mechanical wear. NASA astronauts Chris Williams and Jessica Meir replaced the faulty joint during U.S. Spacewalk 95 on June 30, 2026, restoring the arm to full operation. The failed joint returned to Earth aboard CRS-35 for engineering analysis.How many iROSA solar arrays does the ISS now have?Eight. The ISS Roll-Out Solar Array program installed arrays across four SpaceX Dragon cargo missions — CRS-22 (June 2021), CRS-26 (November 2022), CRS-28 (June 2023), and CRS-35 (October–November 2026). Each array sits atop one of the station's existing solar wing masts and supplements its power output. All eight are now installed and operational.

records.title: SoftBank’s $1 Trillion SK Hynix Idea Was Bigger Than SoftBank
records.excerpt: SoftBank's SK Hynix buyout idea was 2.2x everything it owns. Its debt rule covers about $55B; the rest would ride on peak memory profits. News SoftBank’s $1 Trillion SK Hynix Idea Was Bigger Than SoftBank Posted on November 23, 2026 November 23, 2026 by Flavia Moura 23 Nov Son’s own 25% loan-to-value rule leaves room for roughly $55 billion of SoftBank money. The other $945 billion would have had to be borrowed against SK hynix itself, at a price set by the best quarter SK hynix has ever had. Masayoshi Son sounded out Wall Street about financing a roughly $1 trillion buyout of SK hynix, then dropped it. The arithmetic was against him from the start: SoftBank’s own debt policy covers about 5.5% of that price, so the rest would have been a loan against SK hynix’s peak memory profits. Picture the meeting. Son walks into a room of bankers with the world’s leading supplier of AI memory on the menu. SK hynix just earned 83.3 trillion won in operating profit in a single quarter, at an 80% margin. On that quarter alone, $1 trillion looks like a bargain. Then a credit analyst asks the question every lender asks. Not “what did it earn last quarter?” but “what did it earn in its worst year?” And the answer, from 2023, is a loss. That gap between the quarter that sets the price and the year that sets the loan is the whole story. Everything else, Seoul included, is a second wall behind the first. What Happened On Friday, November 20, The Information reported that Son had recently approached Wall Street institutions about financing a possible buyout of SK hynix valued at around $1 trillion, citing people familiar with the matter. The deal is not happening, and both sides said so fast: SoftBank: a spokesperson told The Information, “SoftBank explores many opportunities, and this one is no longer under active consideration.” SK hynix: the company told Reuters it had no knowledge of the matter, and added that Korean law requires prior government approval for any foreign acquisition of the company. EE Times read the episode as a financing inquiry rather than a takeover attempt: no term sheet, no price talks, no sign any bank committed money. The Information itself flagged the same obstacles. Nobody had shown they would lend the money, and there was no sign SK Group wanted to sell. The price tag is what made headlines. SK hynix closed Friday at a market value of 777.5 trillion won, about $577 billion, according to Aju Press. A $1 trillion price is 73% above that. The Backstory Son has done this before, at a smaller scale and with a very different kind of company. In 2006, SoftBank bought Vodafone’s Japanese mobile business for 1.75 trillion yen. Per The Japan Times, SoftBank itself supplied 200 billion yen of that, about 11% of the price. The rest came mostly from a 1.28 trillion yen bridge loan, which SoftBank’s own releases called the largest leveraged buyout ever in Japan. Then came the clever part. SoftBank refinanced the bridge with a 1.45 trillion yen whole business securitization, a structure where lenders are repaid from the cash flow of the business being bought. In plain terms, Vodafone Japan’s phone customers paid for their own takeover. SoftBank’s CFO Yoshimitsu Goto later wrote that consolidated net leverage stood at 6.2 times right after that acquisition. It worked because phone bills arrive every month, in good years and bad. Japan Times noted at the time that the mobile business’s earnings were considered more stable than SoftBank’s other operations. Fast forward twenty years and SoftBank is a very different animal. It is an investment holding company with: Arm , the chip designer it controls Ampere and a stake in Intel on the processor side DigitalBridge and SB Energy on the data center and power side OpenAI , where it has committed about $64.6 billion Memory is the one layer of the AI stack Son does not own a piece of. That is the “complete the value chain” story you will read everywhere this week, and it is true as far as it goes. It just skips the part about who pays. SoftBank also has recent form on cross-border chip and robotics deals not closing. China blocked its $5.4 billion purchase of ABB’s robotics unit earlier this month over data leaving the country. Seoul’s reported reaction to the SK hynix idea was no warmer: a senior government official quoted by the Seoul Economic Daily said public opinion would hardly favor it. How the Money Would Have Worked SoftBank runs on one rule that matters more than any strategy deck. Its loan-to-value ratio, net debt divided by the equity value of everything it holds, stays below 25% in normal times, with a hard ceiling of 35% in an emergency. CFO Goto is unusually blunt about what that rule does. In SoftBank’s latest annual report, he writes that “SBG does not operate with a fixed investment budget.” The LTV policy is the budget. Deals that fit it get financing lined up with banks before anyone announces anything. Deals that would push LTV past the limit, in his words, would require further deliberation. So the financing call is not a side detail. It is step one of how SoftBank decides. Here is what that step would have run into, using SoftBank’s own September 30 figures from its November 10 earnings deck: SoftBank Group, Sep 30, 2026 Yen USD (at 157.35) Equity value of holdings 71.1 trillion ~$452B Net debt (holdings minus NAV) ~11.3 trillion ~$72B Net asset value 59.8 trillion ~$380B Loan-to-value 15.9% Cash on hand (Seoul Economic Daily) 5.39 trillion ~$34B $1 trillion buyout ~157 trillion 2.2x all holdings Now do the math SoftBank’s treasury team would do. Any dollar SoftBank puts in from its own balance sheet, whether cash or fresh corporate borrowing, adds to net debt and adds the same amount to holdings. Solve for the point where LTV hits 25%, and SoftBank can put in about 8.6 trillion yen, roughly $55 billion . That is 5.5 cents of every dollar of a $1 trillion price. It gets tighter. SoftBank’s own deck put NAV at about 44.7 trillion yen at November 9 prices, after Arm’s share price slid. Hold net debt at its September level and LTV is already about 20%, which leaves room for roughly $23 billion before the 25% line. Even stretching to the 35% emergency ceiling only gets SoftBank to about $133 billion on September values. For comparison, SoftBank funded about 11% of Vodafone Japan from its own pocket. On SK hynix, its own policy caps the check at somewhere between 2% and 5.5%. So where does the other $945 billion come from? There are only two places: Partners’ equity. The Stargate model, where SoftBank brings co-investors and keeps a slice. At that ratio, SoftBank would be a minority sponsor of its own deal. Debt secured on SK hynix. SoftBank’s methodology nets asset-backed loans out of both sides of the LTV calculation, and Goto says asset-backed finance gets priority when conditions allow. A loan secured on SK hynix shares or cash flow would largely stay out of the ratio. That is the Vodafone playbook, and it is why the call went to Wall Street. Either way, the money has to be underwritten against SK hynix’s earnings. Which raises the only question that matters: which earnings? The Business Model Angle Here is the number nobody multiplied. Take the reported $1 trillion, which the Seoul Economic Daily converts to about 1,347 trillion won, and divide it by SK hynix’s operating profit across the last few years of its own reported results. The same price is four different deals depending on which year you trust: On Q3 2026 annualized (83.3 trillion won a quarter), $1 trillion is about 4.0 times operating profit. On the first nine months of 2026, annualized , it is about 5.6 times . On full-year 2025 (47.2 trillion won, itself a record at the time), it is about 28.5 times . On full-year 2024 (23.5 trillion won), it is about 57 times . On 2023 , there is no multiple at all. SK hynix lost 7.7 trillion won at the operating line that year. Run the debt side the same way. records.title: SoftBank Elevates Arm's Haas to Vice Chair as Robotics Deal Backup Plan Takes Shape
records.excerpt: SoftBank promotes Arm CEO Rene Haas to board vice chairman from Dec 1, while Arm keeps him as chief executive until 2033 and he leads SoftBank Group International. SoftBank , Elevates SoftBank Elevates Arm's Haas to Vice Chair as Robotics Deal Backup Plan Takes Shape Published on 11/23/2026 at 20:30 | Editorial boerse-global.de SoftBank promotes Arm CEO Rene Haas to board vice chairman from Dec 1, while Arm keeps him as chief executive until 2033 and he leads SoftBank Group International. SoftBank Group Illustration mit AI erstellt. SoftBank Group is promoting Arm chief executive Rene Haas to vice chairman of its board effective December 1, the conglomerate said, lifting the rank of a director who already sits on the panel rather than bringing a newcomer into the fold. Haas's board membership dates back well before the announcement — Arm's mandatory disclosure of April 21 confirms he was already serving — so the change is one of standing, not affiliation. SoftBank's personnel release did not spell out what the vice chair duties involve or how much of his week they will consume. What the group did make clear is that Haas stays put at Arm. The chip designer simultaneously unveiled a new agreement keeping him at the helm until 2033, a commitment that sits awkwardly with any suggestion he is heading for the exit toward group headquarters. His centre of gravity therefore remains the Cambridge-based licensor. The SoftBank side is no ceremonial post, however, and the substance lies less in the new title than in the job he took on in the spring. As head of SoftBank Group International (SBGI), Haas carries an operational mandate to coordinate portfolio companies across semiconductors and artificial intelligence. Arm's report for fiscal 2026 states that the appointment is meant to strengthen integration with SoftBank's holdings. That same report lays out the flip side. The SBGI role was framed at its April announcement as limited and part-time, yet Arm explicitly warns that the two positions may compete for Haas's time and attention, that conflicts of interest could arise, and that Arm itself may suffer as a result. Companies do not commit such language to their risk disclosures over a post with no work attached. Should investors sell immediately? Or is it worth buying SoftBank Group? The vice chairmanship thus lands on a situation that is already stretched: Haas runs a listed company while coordinating, for its largest shareholder, other holdings whose interests need not always align with Arm's. SoftBank is raising the rank of a board member; Haas is not moving into group management. Arm has locked in his core role through the new agreement, but his SoftBank work via SBGI is operational today, creating a dual responsibility whose potential consequences fall chiefly on Arm. ABB Prepares a Listing Backstop Separately, ABB said it is weighing an initial public offering of its robotics division should the $5.4 billion sale to SoftBank prove unsalvageable. China has blocked the transaction, and Reuters reported that the parties were examining ways on Friday to restructure the planned deal. SoftBank chief Masayoshi Son had explored, according to Reuters information, how a possible $1 trillion acquisition of SK Hynix might be financed. A SoftBank Group spokesperson said on Saturday that the company is no longer actively pursuing the potential purchase. SoftBank Group at a turning point? This analysis reveals what investors need to know now. The stock rose 10% today, having come under pressure on Friday amid a selloff in Asian technology shares. CNBC attributed Friday's selling to Anthropic's market debut failing to restore confidence in AI stocks, with SoftBank — given its large OpenAI exposure — particularly sensitive to sentiment in the sector. For the first half of fiscal 2026, SoftBank reported a net loss attributable to owners of the parent of ¥768.0 billion, swinging from a net profit of ¥2.92 trillion a year earlier. The company also booked a loss of ¥597.2 billion tied to revised procurement plans for power generation facilities at US AI data centres. records.title: Takata airbags prompt Honda and Toyota to recall 1.6 million cars
records.excerpt: Takata airbags prompt Honda and Toyota to recall 1.6 million cars LM DH Lisa Monica, Ramdhani Pratama 22 November 2026, 11:00 WIB LM Lisa Monica Reporter DH Ramdhani Pratama Reporter WhatsApp Channel Honda and Toyota recall 1.6 million US vehicles over airbag risks. JAKARTA - Automotive manufacturers Honda and Toyota are recalling approximately 1.6 million cars, trucks and SUVs in the United States (US) due to the risk of Takata airbag inflators rupturing. Both manufacturers have urged owners of affected vehicles to have the components replaced to prevent potential injuries. As reported by Reuters , Honda and Toyota said they had received no reports of accidents or injuries involving vehicles covered by the latest recall. Both companies also confirmed that no airbag inflator ruptures had occurred in vehicles included in the recall programme. Read Also: Bahlil rules out mining permits in Ujung Kulon National Park Nevertheless, they will replace the airbag inflators in affected vehicles as a precautionary measure. The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said that analysis and simulations of inflator degradation conducted by an independent testing group had enabled manufacturers to take action before the risks materialised. "Honda and Toyota have seen early evidence of potential degradation risks in certain vehicles and are currently conducting proactive vehicle recalls," NHTSA said. NHTSA added that other automotive manufacturers were continuing to analyse and test their airbag inflators. The recalls cover 810,592 older Honda cars and SUVs in the US and 790,000 Toyota vehicles worldwide, including 314,000 units in the US. For Toyota, the affected models include the 2002-2010 Lexus SC430, 2011 Lexus IS250, 2017 Lexus GX460, 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla, 2005-2006 Toyota Tundra, 2005-2007 Toyota Sequoia and 2016-2017 Toyota 4Runner. Meanwhile, Honda's recall covers several models, including the 2013 Honda Accord, 2012-2013 Civic, 2012-2013 CR-V, 2013 Acura ILX and 2013 Acura RDX. Honda's recall programme applies to vehicles originally sold or registered in 14 US states or territories. Airbag Risks Have Caused Fatalities The Takata airbag inflator defect has become one of the biggest automotive safety scandals in US history. Since 2009, at least 28 people have died and more than 400 have been injured in the country due to defective Takata airbag inflators. All the fatalities involved airbag inflators without a desiccant. At least 20 of those killed were travelling in Honda vehicles. Unlike in previous cases, the vehicles covered by the latest recall use airbag inflators containing moisture-absorbing material. Nevertheless, Honda identified signs of degradation in the propellant material of several inflators in certain geographical areas following long-term monitoring and analysis. Toyota also warned that degradation of the propellant material could cause the inflator to rupture when the airbag deploys. Over the past decade, approximately 24 automotive manufacturers have recalled more than 100 million vehicles fitted with Takata airbag inflators worldwide. Around 67 million of these vehicles were in the US. A defective inflator can cause the airbag canister to explode during deployment, sending metal fragments flying into the vehicle cabin. In several cases, the components have caused fatalities and injuries to drivers and passengers. Similar concerns have also emerged in Australia. Lexus has recalled more than 7,000 vehicles over concerns about the degradation of Takata airbag inflators. The recall covers several Lexus models, including the IS250, IS250C, IS350 and IS-F manufactured between 2005 and 2012. So far, it remains unclear whether other vehicles in Australia are also affected by the latest global recall programme. Owners of vehicles included in the recall can check their vehicle status through the Australian Government's official Vehicle Recalls website or contact the relevant manufacturer. Repairs through authorised dealerships, including the replacement of defective airbags, will be provided free of charge to vehicle owners. records.label: caranddriver.com
records.title: Honda Issues Yet Another Recall for 810,592 Cars Equipped with Takata Airbags That Could Rupture
records.excerpt: The recall population includes some Acura RDX, ILX, Honda CR-V, Civic, and Accord vehicles supplied by the company that sold millions of deadly airbags. Honda issued a recall for 810,592 vehicles equipped with airbag inflators that might rupture due to propellant degradation caused by humidity. The affected vehicles are all equipped with airbags from the supplier Takata, which is infamous for selling millions of dangerously defective airbags.The recall covers some Acura RDX, ILX, Honda CR-V (pictured above), Civic, and Accord models from the 2012 and 2013 model years. Somehow, after all these years, there are still a considerable number of vehicles equipped with Takata airbags, though their number should be considerably lower in the near future. Honda just issued a recall for 810,592 cars equipped with Takata airbags that could rupture due to propellant degradation caused by high humidity.According to documents filed with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), the recall covers some 2013 Acura RDX, ILX, Honda CR-V, Civic, and Accord models. The affected Accords and Acuras are all from the 2013 model year, while the CR-V and Civic populations include both 2012 and 2013 vehicles.The NHTSA documents show that the affected vehicles are equipped with airbag inflators that use a phase-stabilized ammonium nitrate propellant, which is intended to control moisture within the inflator. Over time, exposure to high humidity and repeated temperature changes can cause the inflator to become brittle. When the brittle inflators are deployed, they could turn into projectiles that shoot metal fragments through the cabin, potentially injuring or killing occupants.The recall comes after years of investigation and analysis by Honda, which was routinely shared with NHTSA. The recall documents show that on November 19, 2026, Honda determined that the inflators posed enough of a risk to warrant the new recall.Owners of affected models will be contacted by mail and urged to bring their vehicle to a Honda or Acura dealership. Dealer technicians will replace the driver and passenger airbag inflators with a different model for free. Dealers have already been notified of the recall, with owner notification letters scheduled to be sent on December 18. Owners concerned that their car might be included in the recall can check on the NHTSA recalls site as well as NHTSA’s dedicated Takata airbag recall page.

records.label: roadandtrack.com
records.title: Toyota, Honda Recalling 1.6 Million More Vehicles Over Faulty Takata Airbags
records.excerpt: Bad airbag inflators from the Chinese supplier continue to plague late-model vehicles 18 years after the initial recall. 18 years after Honda filed the first official airbag recall and 12 years since the first round of mass recalls began, the Takata airbag scandal remains ongoing. This month, Honda and Toyota have both filed new recalls with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration related to faulty airbag inflators.The pair of recalls filed in November include a population of more than 1.6 million vehicles. Late-model Hondas make up over 810,000 units in the recall, while Toyota accounts for 790,000 units, 314,000 of which are located in the United States. NHTSA documents indicate that 2013 Honda Accord, 2012-2013 Honda Civic, 2012-2013 Honda CR-V, 2013 Acura ILX, 2013 Acura RDX models, 2002-2010 Lexus SC430, 2011 ‌IS250, ⁠2017 GX460, 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla, 2005-2006 Tundra, 2005-2007 Sequoia and 2016-2017 4Runner models are included in the recall.Despite the growing recall population, the core issue remains generally unchanged from previous Takata recalls. “The airbag inflator propellant can degrade with repeated exposure to high-humidity environments and large temperature variation, resulting in increased internal pressure. If an affected airbag deploys, the increased internal pressure may cause the inflator to rupture (break apart) and deploy abnormally,” NHTSA documents explain. “In the event of an inflator rupture, metal fragments could pass through the airbag cushion material possibly causing serious injury or fatality to vehicle occupants.”There have been no injuries or crashes tied to the vehicles being newly recalled. However, NHTSA has recorded 28 deaths in the United States and more than 400 injuries stemming from defective Takata airbag inflators since 2009. The Takata airbag recall remains the largest recall in U.S. history.Given the rolling nature of the Takata recall, Honda and Toyota were already in discussions with federal regulators when this airbag version began to show signs of degradation. Honda first identified an issue during simulation testing under severe environmental conditions in May 2025. However, these tests didn’t show abnormal inflator behavior or a “statistically significant deviation” from previous prediction models. Similarly, Toyota had been collecting and studying certain Takata inflators since 2016, specifically focusing on a desiccated, phase-stabilized ammonium nitrate (PSAN) propellant. Toyota’s predictive models indicated that some of these inflators could be reaching the end of their life, prompting the Japanese automaker to conduct a voluntary safety recall.The remedy is fairly simple for both automakers: Toyota and Honda will simply replace the airbag inflators on affected units. Honda says its new inflators are manufactured by a different supplier and use a different propellant that does not degrade over the long term when exposed to high temperatures, high humidity, and large temperature fluctuations. Either way, both automakers and federal regulators urge affected owners to have their airbag inflators swapped out as soon as possible.

Log in Honda has issued a recall covering more than 810,000 vehicles over concerns that its airbag inflators could potentially rupture. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration reported that the safety action impacts 810,592 automobiles. Specifically, the recall applies to 2012–2013 Honda Civic and CR-V models, 2013 Honda Accords, along with 2013 Acura ILX and RDX vehicles. Regulators at the NHTSA explained that the affected cars feature certain Takata front driver and passenger airbag inflators. Extended exposure to high absolute humidity combined with severe temperature changes can cause the internal propellant to degrade, creating a rupture hazard. The issue lies with a small batch of wheels on Honda Civics from 2016 to 2021 ( Justin Sullivan/Getty Images ) A bursting inflator can launch sharp metal fragments into the cabin, threatening drivers and passengers with critical injuries or death. The move contributes to the recall of tens of millions of Takata airbags, standing among the largest product recalls ever recorded. Authorized dealerships will install replacement front driver or passenger airbag inflators at no cost to owners. Notification letters advising drivers of the hazard are scheduled for dispatch on Dec. 18, with further correspondence to follow when repair parts are ready. Drivers can contact Honda customer support at 1-888-234-2138, call the NHTSA hotline at 1-888-327-4236, or check www.nhtsa.gov . records.title: If Your 2012 or 2013 Honda CR-V or Civic Was Ever Registered in These 14 Places, Its Takata Airbag Is Being Recalled
records.excerpt: The Takata airbag recall nightmare is back in the news, years after the original problem. This mess isn’t going away, and a lot of Honda CR-Vs and Honda Civics are involved. Skip to main content If Your 2012 or 2013 Honda CR-V or Civic Was Ever Registered in These 14 Places, Its Takata Airbag Is Being Recalled The Takata airbag recall nightmare is back in the news, years after the original problem. This mess isn’t going away, and a lot of Honda CR-Vs and Honda Civics are involved. Advertising November 23, 2026 - 2:30PM EST By: Tim Healey If your 2012 or 2013 Honda CR-V or Civic was ever registered in one of 14 hot, humid places, its Takata airbag inflator is being recalled. Honda is recalling 810,592 vehicles, including 197,045 CR-Vs and 413,125 Civics, and these inflators contain a moisture-absorbing desiccant that was supposed to make them the safe ones. The recall also covers the 2013 Honda Accord, Acura RDX, and Acura ILX, and Honda says no ruptures, injuries, or deaths have been reported. Here is how to tell if your Honda is affected, even if it has since moved to another state. Which Hondas Are in the New Takata Airbag Recall Here is how the 810,592 vehicles break down by model. Vehicle Units Recalled 2012 to 2013 Honda Civic 413,125 2012 to 2013 Honda CR-V 197,045 2013 Honda Accord 165,225 2013 Acura RDX 20,554 2013 Acura ILX 14,643 Total 810,592 These inflators use a phase-stabilized ammonium nitrate propellant, with a desiccant meant to control moisture. Earlier Takata recalls covered inflators without that desiccant, which is why these were long considered safer. Over many years, high humidity and large temperature swings can still degrade the propellant and make the inflator brittle. If a brittle inflator deploys, it can rupture and send metal fragments through the cabin, which can cause serious injury or death. Honda worked with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration for years to study these inflators. It has now decided the risk in certain regions is high enough to recall them as a preventive step. The 14 Places Covered by the Honda Takata Airbag Recall The recall covers vehicles originally sold or ever registered in these nine states and five US territories. Alabama California Florida Georgia Hawaii Louisiana Mississippi South Carolina Texas Puerto Rico U.S. Virgin Islands Northern Mariana Islands (Saipan) Guam American Samoa These places share high heat, high humidity, and large temperature swings. Those are the conditions Honda says can degrade the propellant over time. The key words are "ever registered." A CR-V first sold in Florida and later moved to Ohio or New York is still covered, so used car owners should check, especially anyone who has compared used CR-Vs across model years and bought an older one. What Honda Says About the Newly Recalled Inflators Honda explained the recall in a statement. "American Honda will recall 810,592 vehicles in the United States to replace, for free, their Takata front driver and/or passenger airbag inflators that contain a moisture absorbing desiccant." "Long-term monitoring and analysis of in-market desiccated inflators by Honda revealed potential propellent degradation in certain inflators within specific geographic regions, prompting this preventative action. No inflator ruptures or associated injuries or fatalities have been reported related to the newly recalled inflators." Honda says mailed notices begin in December 2026. It is urging owners to visit an authorized dealer as soon as they receive one. This is not one of NHTSA's Takata "Do Not Drive" warnings, which cover older inflators without a desiccant and a known high rupture risk. The advice here is to get the free repair as soon as you are notified. How to Check If Your Honda CR-V or Civic Is Affected Check your VIN now at recalls.honda.com or recalls.acura.com, or call Honda at (888) 234-2138. Honda announced the recall of 810,592 Honda and Acura vehicles on Nov. 20 in a company statement . Toyota announced its recall of about 314,000 Toyota and Lexus vehicles on Nov. 12 in a recall notice . Neither company said it was aware of any ruptures involving the recalled inflators. Which Honda and Acura Models Are Recalled Honda's recall covers certain: Advertisement Advertisement 2012-2013 Honda Civic 2012-2013 Honda CR-V 2013 Honda Accord 2013 Acura ILX 2013 Acura RDX Only vehicles originally sold or ever registered in areas with high heat, high humidity and large temperature swings are included, Honda said. The list covers Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Louisiana, Mississippi, South Carolina and Texas, as well as Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, the Northern Mariana Islands, Guam and American Samoa. Which Toyota and Lexus Models Are Recalled Toyota's recall covers the front passenger airbag in certain: 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla (232,174 vehicles) 2016-2017 Toyota 4Runner (35,949) 2005-2006 Toyota Tundra (25,174) 2005-2007 Toyota Sequoia (10,736) 2017 Lexus GX 460 (8,931) 2002-2010 Lexus SC 430 (1,064) 2011 Lexus IS 250 (1) Advertisement Advertisement The model years and vehicle counts come from Toyota's recall report to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. Unlike Honda's recall, Toyota's is not limited to specific states. "No inflator ruptures or associated injuries or fatalities have been reported related to the newly recalled inflator types," Honda said. Faulty Takata inflators led to the largest auto safety recall in U.S. history. The company said it will begin mailing notices to owners in December. A second notice will be sent once a permanent repair is available, CNN reported. records.excerpt: Honda is recalling 810,000 vehicles over Takata airbag inflator risk Subscribe Autos Honda is recalling 810,000 vehicles over Takata airbag rupture risk The recall covers certain 2012-2013 Honda and Acura models in 14 states and territories, and no ruptures have been reported By Cris Tolomia · 2 min read · Updated November 23, 2026 Add QZ to Google Brandon Bell / Getty Images Honda $HMC is recalling 810,592 vehicles in the U.S. to replace Takata airbag inflators that show potential propellant degradation, the company said on Nov. 20. Dealers will swap out the inflators in the driver or passenger front airbags, and owners will not be charged. Honda said no inflator ruptures, injuries or deaths have been reported in connection with the newly recalled inflators. The company described the recall as a preventive action. Degraded inflators could burst when they have been subjected for a prolonged period to heavy humidity and big temperature swings, according to Fox Business . "An inflator rupture may result in sharp metal fragments striking the driver or other occupants, resulting in serious injury or death," the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said in its recall notice, according to Fox Business. The recall covers certain 2013 Honda Accord, 2012-2013 Honda Civic, 2012-2013 Honda CR-V, 2013 Acura ILX and 2013 Acura RDX vehicles. It applies to vehicles sold or registered in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Louisiana, Mississippi, South Carolina, Texas, Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, the Northern Mariana Islands, Guam and American Samoa. Honda said those locations are known for high temperatures, high humidity and large temperature fluctuations. Unlike the inflators in earlier Takata recalls, the inflators in question include a desiccant that soaks up moisture, Honda said. Its ongoing review of desiccated inflators in the field turned up signs that the propellant may be breaking down in some units in particular regions. Honda will begin mailing notifications to customers in December. Interim letters are expected to go out on Dec. 18, and further notices will follow when the permanent fix is ready, according to Fox Business. Owners can check their vehicles' recall status at www.recalls.honda.com and www.recalls.acura.com, or call (888) 234-2138. Honda urged owners of affected vehicles to take them to an authorized dealer for repair as soon as they receive a notice. Toyota $TM is also recalling 314,029 vehicles in the U.S. over Takata-made inflators that can rupture. The Toyota recall covers 790,000 vehicles worldwide, according to NBC News . Defective Takata inflators have been linked to at least 28 deaths and more than 400 injuries in the U.S. since 2009, according to NBC News. Every one of those deaths was tied to inflators that lacked a desiccant, and at least 20 occurred in Honda vehicles. NHTSA said Honda and Toyota acted on early evidence of degradation risk. records.excerpt: Title: Honda and Toyota Recall 1.1M Vehicles In the U.S. Over Takata Airbag Rupture Risk URL Source: http://www.latintimes.com/honda-toyota-recall-takata-airbag-risk-601696 Final URL: https://www.latintimes.com/honda-toyota-recall-takata-airbag-risk-601696 Published Time: 2026-11-22T19:28:26-05:00 Markdown Content: ![Image 1: Honda Issues Recalls 750,000 Vehicles In The U.S. Due To ](https://d.latintimes.com/en/full/595213/honda-issues-recalls-750000-vehicles-us-due.jpg?w=736&f=db36184810834cf5a9723be6c04106b7) SAN RAFAEL, CALIFORNIA - FEBRUARY 06: A sign is posted in front of Honda Marin on February 06, 2024 in San Rafael, California. Honda announced the recall of 750,000 vehicles in the U.S. for an air bag defect that could unintentionally deploy the air bags in a collision. The recall includes certain 2020 to 2022 Honda Pilot, Accord and Civic vehicles as well as 2020 and 2021 model years of Honda CR-V and Passport vehicles. Photo by Justin Sullivan/Getty Images * * * ### The Briefing: * Honda and Toyota announced a combined recall of approximately 1.1 million vehicles in the [United States](https://www.latintimes.com/topics/united-states "United States") on Fr iday, citing a risk that aging Takata-manufactured airbag inflators could rupture during deployment and send metal fragments into the passenger cabin. * Honda's U.S. recall covers 810,592 vehicles originally sold or registered in nine high-heat states and five U.S. territories; Toyota's U.S. portion covers 314,029 vehicles across seven Toyota and Lexus model lines spanning model years 2002 to 2017. * Neither automaker has reported any inflator ruptures, injuries, or deaths tied to the specific units now under recall; both companies will replace the affected inflators free of charge at authorized dealerships, with Honda owner letters going out in December 2026. * * * Honda Motor and Toyota Motor jointly disclosed on Friday a combined safety action covering rough ly [1.1 million vehicles](https://asia.nikkei.com/business/automobiles/honda-toyota-recall-1.6m-vehicles-over-takata-airbag-rupture-risk) in the United States, where certain older models carry a risk of airbag inflator rupture that could send m etal shrapnel through the airbag cushion at dangerous speeds. The two Japanese automakers confirmed that no injuries, crashes, or inflator failures have been linked to the recalled units, and that dealers will perform the repairs at no cost to vehicle owners. ## A Precautionary Step, Not a Road Emergency The recalls were not triggered by a reported incident. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said both automakers had identified early warning signs of propellant degradation through long-term monitoring and analysis conducted with independent testing groups, allowing them to act before any ruptures occurred.[NHTSA confirmed Friday](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/takata-recall-spotlight) th at "Honda and Toyota saw early evidence of degradation risk in certain of their vehicles and are currently conducting proactive recalls," adding that other manufacturers continue to run their own testing of inflators across their respective fleets. ## Two Recalls, Two Distinct Situations What sets Honda's action apart from Toyota's — and from the deadliest chapters of the broader Takata saga — is the specific hardware involved. [Honda's official recall](https://hondanews.com/en-US/releases/release-b26ae02ff5dca50cb32a1f47831d8dd1-statement-by-american-honda-regarding-takata-desiccated-airbag-inflator-recall)specifically targets front airbag inflators that contain a moisture-abs orbing desiccant compound, a newer design type that was not part of earlier recall waves. Toyota's U.S. recall, filed with NHTSA on November 12, covers front passenger airbag inflators where propellant has degraded from prolonged exposure to high temperatures and humidity, rendering them capable of rupturing if the airbag deploys. In both cases, a compromised inflator [can burst violently](https://www.autoevolution.com/news/810592-honda-and-acura-vehicles-recalled-in-the-us-market-over-takata-produced-airbag-inflators-278786.html) upon activation, turning metal components into projectiles inside the cabin. ## The Weight of a Deadly Record The broader Takata airbag scandal stands as one of the most consequential product failures in automotive hi story. [NHTSA's Takata portal](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/takata-recall-spotlight) lists 28 confirmed U.S. deaths and more than 400 injuries linked to rupturing inflators since 2009, with Honda vehicles accounting for the largest share of those fatalities. All deaths recorded in prior recall campaigns involved non-desiccated inflators — a critical distinction from the components addressed in Honda's current action. Globally, more than a dozen major manufacturers have recalled over 100 million vehicles equipped with Takata components, with roughly 67 million of those vehicles located in the United States alone. ## Honda's Recall: Nine States and Five U.S. Territories American Honda's recall campaign covers 810,592 vehicles in geographic zones identified for their combination of intense heat, persistent humidity, and wide seasonal temperature swings. The nine included states are Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Louisiana, Mississippi, South Carolina, and Texas. The five U.S. territories covered are Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands (Saipan), and American Samoa. The five affected Honda and Acura nameplates are the 2013 Honda Accord, the 2012 and 2013 Honda Civic, the 2012 and 2013 Honda CR-V, the 2013 Acura ILX, and the 2013 Acura RDX. Long-term field monitoring revealed signs of propellant degradation concentrated in desiccant-equipped inflators exposed to those climate conditions. Owner notification letters are scheduled to begin in December 2026, with repairs performed at no charge once replacement parts become available. Owners may also call Honda at 1-888-234-2138 or check status a t [Honda's recall site](https://www.recalls.honda.com/). ## Toyota's Recall: Seven Nameplates, Nearly Two Decades of Production Toyota Motor North America's recall covers 314,029 vehicles in the United States and approximately 790,000 worldwide. We are instead going to talk about a recall notice issued by Honda a few days ago, involving well over 16,000 vehicles in the United States. They are all S2000s of the AP2 variety, meaning the second generation introduced for the model-year 2004. So, what is this all about? Fuel Flange Joints Are The Main Culprits Here Honda The AP2-gen S2000 is the one powered by Honda’s 2.2-liter F22C1 engine, with the affected model-years being 2004 and 2005. records.title: Cochlear implant pioneers share prestigious Honda Prize
records.excerpt: Professor Graeme Clark and Dr Ingeborg Hochmair have received one of Japan’s highest international honours for their pioneering contributions to modern cochlear implant technology. University of Melbourne Laureate Professor Graeme Clark AC’s daughter Merran Larratt and grandson Nicholas Larratt travelled to Japan to accept the award on his behalf MED-EL co-founder and CEO Dr Ingeborg Hochmair received her award at the ceremony in Tokyo on 16 November 2026. The two pioneers who developed the cochlear implant and whose research helped establish modern cochlear implant technology have been jointly awarded the 2026 Honda Prize, recognising more than five decades of innovation that has transformed hearing restoration worldwide Presented annually by the Honda Foundation, the prize recognises achievements in science and technology that contribute to society. The pair were honoured for spearheading the research, development, clinical application and worldwide adoption of multichannel cochlear implants. Professor Clark is only the second Australian to receive the award. It is his third major international honour this year for both of the cochlear implant pioneers, following the Queen Elizabeth Prize for Engineering in February and the Richard N. Merkin Prize in Biomedical Technology in June. Prof Clark’s recognition comes almost five decades after his University of Melbourne team performed the world’s first successful multichannel cochlear implant surgery in 1978. “When I began my research, my goal was to find a way for people with severe hearing loss to understand speech,” Professor Clark said. “These awards show what can be achieved through collaboration between researchers, clinicians, engineers and industry and, importantly, the people who placed their trust in the underlying research results and in this technology.” Dr Hochmair’s contribution to cochlear implant development also dates to the 1970s, when she and her husband, Professor Erwin Hochmair, developed the world’s first microelectronic multichannel cochlear implant. The device was successfully implanted in a patient in Vienna in 1977, marking a significant milestone in the development of modern hearing implants. The couple later co-founded MED-EL, helping bring hearing implant technology from the research laboratory into clinical practice. Today, the company’s hearing solutions are used in more than 142 countries and have helped hundreds of thousands of people access sound and communication. “When we began this work more than fifty years ago, restoring hearing through electronics seemed impossible to many,” Dr Hochmair said. “Seeing how this technology has helped people around the world remains the greatest reward.” She accepted the award on behalf of the scientists, engineers, clinicians, patients and families who had contributed to the journey, highlighting collaboration and perseverance as central to the field’s progress. Both laureates also pointed to the importance of continuing innovation and expanding access to hearing solutions. Cochlear CEO and president Dig Howitt said Professor Clark’s three international awards reflected the lasting impact of his work. “Professor Clark’s vision and persistence helped establish the foundations for Cochlear and for an entirely new way of treating severe to profound hearing loss,” he said. The Honda Prize recognises the achievements of two researchers whose pioneering work helped establish the foundations of an industry that continues to advance hearing care and communication for people worldwide.

records.excerpt: Honda has issued a major Takata airbag rupture notice affecting 810,592 vehicles in the United States, raising fresh safety concerns for owners of certain. US News Honda Takata Airbag Rupture Notice: 810,592 Vehicles Recalled, Check If Your Car Is Affected By: Daniel Brooks | Editor: Matthew Reed | Contributor: Ethan Parker November 24, 2026 at 12:49 AM WITA · 5 min read Honda has announced a recall of 810,592 vehicles in the United States due to potential Takata airbag inflator rupture risks. illustration / Aktualita.co. WASHINGTON, Aktualita.co - Honda has issued a major Takata airbag rupture notice affecting 810,592 vehicles in the United States, raising fresh safety concerns for owners of certain older Honda and Acura models. The recall, announced on November 20, 2026, involves airbag inflators that could rupture during deployment, potentially sending dangerous metal fragments into the passenger compartment. According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), the affected vehicles include select Honda Accord, Civic, and CR-V models, along with Acura ILX and RDX vehicles manufactured for the 2012 and 2013 model years. The announcement comes as automakers continue addressing safety concerns involving Takata airbag technology, years after the original defects triggered one of the largest automotive recall campaigns in history. Although Honda has not reported any inflator ruptures, injuries, or fatalities involving the components covered by this latest recall, the company is taking preventive action following long-term testing and analysis. Which Honda and Acura Models Are Included in the Takata Airbag Recall? Honda's latest safety recall covers five vehicle lines, although not every vehicle from the listed model years is necessarily affected. The recalled vehicles include: 2012–2013 Honda Civic: 413,125 vehicles 2012–2013 Honda CR-V: 197,045 vehicles 2013 Honda Accord: 165,225 vehicles 2013 Acura RDX: 20,554 vehicles 2013 Acura ILX: 14,643 vehicles Together, these models account for 810,592 potentially affected vehicles nationwide. The recall is registered under NHTSA campaign number 26V765 , with Honda manufacturer recall codes BQK, MQJ, KQI, and QQH. Vehicle owners should understand that the recall applies to specific vehicles based on their manufacturing and registration histories rather than simply their model year. A vehicle identification number (VIN) check is therefore the most reliable way to determine whether a particular car requires repair. Which States Are Affected by the Honda Takata Airbag Rupture Notice? Unlike some earlier nationwide Takata recalls, Honda's newly announced action focuses on vehicles originally sold or ever registered in geographic areas associated with high temperatures, humidity, and significant temperature fluctuations. The affected locations include Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Louisiana, Mississippi, South Carolina, and Texas. The recall also covers Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam, American Samoa, and the Northern Mariana Islands, including Saipan. These regions were identified because environmental conditions may accelerate the deterioration of certain airbag inflator components. Importantly, a vehicle may still qualify for the recall even if it has subsequently been moved to another state. Owners who purchased a used Honda or Acura should check their VIN rather than relying solely on their current state of residence. Why Can Takata Airbag Inflators Rupture? The safety concern centers on the chemical propellant inside the airbag inflator, which generates gas to inflate the airbag during a collision. According to Honda's recall filing, repeated exposure to high humidity and significant temperature changes can gradually degrade the propellant. If deterioration progresses, the propellant may burn faster than intended during airbag deployment, creating excessive internal pressure. That pressure could cause the inflator's metal housing to rupture. In a worst-case scenario, metal fragments could penetrate the airbag cushion and strike occupants, potentially causing serious injuries or death. One important distinction separates this recall from many earlier Takata cases. The newly recalled inflators contain a moisture-absorbing material known as a desiccant, which was designed to help control moisture-related degradation. Earlier Takata recalls largely involved inflators without this moisture-control material. Nevertheless, continued testing has identified potential deterioration risks in some inflators containing a desiccant. Honda Says No Ruptures or Injuries Have Been Reported Honda emphasized that the recall is preventive and that the newly identified inflators have not been linked to reported ruptures or injuries. In its November 20 statement, the automaker said: "No inflator ruptures or associated injuries or fatalities have been reported related to the newly recalled inflators." — American Honda Motor Co., official recall statement, November 20, 2026. Federal safety documents indicate that Honda observed signs of propellant degradation during simulation testing under severe environmental conditions in May 2025. However, the tested inflators remained within normal operating parameters. Following additional investigation, Honda determined on November 19, 2026, that a safety-related defect existed and decided to initiate the recall. The announcement follows a separate Takata-related recall involving Toyota and Lexus vehicles, bringing renewed attention to the long-term reliability of aging airbag systems. How to Check Your Honda for a Takata Airbag Recall Owners who believe their vehicles may be affected can verify their recall status without waiting for a notification letter. The NHTSA provides an official recall lookup service at NHTSA.gov/recalls , where drivers can enter their vehicle's 17-character VIN. The VIN is usually visible near the lower corner of the windshield on the driver's side. It can also be found on vehicle registration and insurance documents. Honda owners can check recalls.honda.com , while Acura owners can use recalls.acura.com . Owners may also contact Honda customer service at 1-888-234-2138 for additional information about the recall. Because newly announced recalls may take time to appear in every lookup database, owners should check again or contact Honda if their vehicle's status remains unclear. When Will Honda Send Recall Notices? Honda plans to begin notifying affected vehicle owners by mail in December 2026. According to its federal recall documentation, owner notification is scheduled for approximately December 18, 2026. Authorized Honda and Acura dealerships will replace the affected driver-side or passenger-side frontal airbag inflators at no cost. The replacement components will come from a different supplier and use a different propellant formulation designed to avoid the long-term degradation associated with the recalled parts. Owners should contact their dealership to confirm repair arrangements and replacement-part availability. The latest filing does not designate this particular campaign as a formal "Do Not Drive" recall, although drivers should follow any additional safety instructions applicable to their individual vehicles. Why the Takata Airbag Problem Still Matters Takata's defective airbag inflators have been associated with at least 28 deaths and more than 400 injuries in the United States since 2009. The broader safety crisis prompted recalls involving tens of millions of vehicles across numerous automotive brands. The latest Honda recall demonstrates that even inflators incorporating additional moisture protection may require attention as vehicles age. For Honda Civic, CR-V, Accord, and Acura owners, the most important step is straightforward: check the vehicle's VIN and arrange the free repair if the recall applies. records.excerpt: Honda CB500 Launched In India: Key Highlights - Overdrive SUBSCRIBE | APP get app Subscribe Trending: Maruti Suzuki e-Vitara Ather Stack 7 Kawasaki Ninja ZX-6R 2025 BMW X5 Yangwang U9 Track Edition Kawasaki KLX 230 Follow us Cars Bikes news reviews compare Advertisement Home News Honda CB500 Launched In India: Key Highlights Shreyash Singh Updated: November 24, 2026, 11:40 AM IST The CB500 is the largest air-cooled single-cylinder offering from Honda Honda recently launched the new CB500 classic roadster motorcycle in India, starting at Rs 2.75 lakh (ex-showroom, Delhi). It is based on the same platform as the Honda CB350 but gets a larger 501cc, air- and oil-cooled engine. Here are 5 key highlights of the CB500: Honda CB500: Engine Starting with the heart, the Honda CB500 uses a 501 cc air- and oil-cooled mill that produces 28 PS at 5,250 rpm and 43.3 Nm at 3,750, paired with a 5-speed manual gearbox. With both peak power and torque arriving at relatively low engine speeds, the CB500 should offer ample low-end grunt and strong pulling power. A slip-and-assist clutch is standard across all variants of the motorcycle. Honda CB500: Chassis, Suspension, And Brakes The CB500 is built on the double-cradle frame with single-downtube chassis, that rests on conventional telescopic front fork and pre-load gas-charged rear twin shock absorbers. It rides on 19-inch front and 17-inch rear wheels, and comes in both alloy and spoke wheel versions. Weighing 189kg, the CB500 is even lighter than the Royal Enfield Classic 350. Braking is handled by disc rotors at both ends. Honda CB500: Design Being a classic roadster, the Honda CB500 features a retro styling with circular LED headlights, rounded chrome side mirrors, and a single piece seat. The engine also gets a chrome finish, complemented by a chrome exhaust setup. Honda is offering the CB500 in a total of 5 colour options: Pearl Deep Ground Gray and Pearl Igneous Black are available with the entry-level alloy wheel variant. The mid-spec cross-spoke variant gets the Matte Silver Metallic and Rebel Red Metallic colour options. While the top-spec variant gets an exclusive Pearl Igneous Black colour option with golden stripes on the fuel tank. Honda CB500: Features Honda has equipped the CB500 with a semi-digital cluster and Honda RoadSync Connectivity, offering Bluetooth connectivity and turn-by-turn navigation support. Other features include a USB Type-C charging port, all LED lighting, dual-channel ABS, and an emergency stop signal (ESS). Honda CB500: Pricing And Competition Honda is offering the CB500 in a total of three variants: Alloy (Rs 2.75 lakh (ex-showroom, Delhi), Spoke (Rs 3 lakh (ex-showroom, Delhi)), and Spoke with Stripes (Rs 3.02 lakh (ex-showroom, Delhi). The CB500 takes on the likes of the BSA GoldStar 650 (Rs 3.65 lakh onwards (ex-showroom, Delhi), Royal Enfield Classic 650 (Rs 3.67 lakh onwards (ex-showroom, Delhi)), and Royal Enfield Bullet 650 (Rs 3.64 lakh onwards (ex-showroom, Delhi)). records.excerpt: 高田气囊已致28名美国人死亡！本田丰田再因气囊召回160万辆汽车--快科技--科技改变未来 手机版 安卓版 苹果端 博客版 登录 注册 作者私密文章，无浏览权限 返回 因版权限制，过往内容只提供给老鸟级别及以上用户访问 登录 因版权限制，过往内容只提供给老鸟级别及以上用户访问 返回 当前位置： 首页 > 资讯中心 > 爱车一族 > 传统汽车 > 文章详情 正文内容 评论（ 0 ） 高田气囊已致28名美国人死亡！本田丰田再因气囊召回160万辆汽车 2026-11-23 15:49:14 出处：快科技 作者： 若风 编辑：若风 评论 ( 0 ) 复制 纠错 # 本田 # 丰田 0 0 QQ好友 微博 微信好友 QQ空间 复制链接 0 0 关闭 AI摘要 内容由AI生成，仅供参考 快科技11月23日消息，据路透社报道，本田和丰田于11月20日宣布， 将在全球范围内召回约160万辆轿车、卡车和SUV，原因是车辆搭载的高田气囊气体发生器存在破裂风险。 其中，本田在美国召回810592辆，丰田在全球召回79万辆（美国市场占31.4万辆）， 两家车企均表示，相关车辆尚未发生人员伤亡、事故或发生器破裂事件，此次属于主动预防性召回。 具体来看，本田召回涉及部分2013款雅阁、2012至2013款思域、2012至2013款CR-V、2013款讴歌ILX和2013款讴歌RDX，覆盖美国14个高温、高湿且温差波动较大的州及属地，包括加利福尼亚、得克萨斯、佛罗里达、夏威夷、波多黎各、关岛等。 丰田召回涉及2002至2010款雷克萨斯SC430、2011款IS250、2017款GX460、2003至2008款卡罗拉、2005至2006款Tundra、2005至2007款Sequoia和2016至2017款4Runner，丰田预计替换用的气体发生器要到2027年初才能备齐。 与以往不同的是， 此次召回车辆的气囊气体发生器内含吸湿干燥剂，这类产品此前被认为相对安全，并未列入召回范围。 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）表示，独立测试机构的分析和发生器劣化模拟模型让车企得以在风险显现前行动，“本田和丰田在部分车辆中发现了劣化风险的早期证据，正在实施主动召回”，其他车企也在继续进行发生器分析和测试。 本田称，长期监测发现特定地理区域内部分发生器存在潜在推进剂劣化，丰田则警告，劣化的推进剂可能导致气囊展开时发生器破裂并造成严重伤害。 据悉，高田气囊缺陷已酿成美国汽车史上最大规模召回。 自2009年以来，美国已有至少28人因此死亡、超过400人受伤，所有死亡案例均涉及不含干燥剂的发生器，其中至少20起发生在本田车上。 过去十年，全球二十多家车企累计召回超过1亿辆搭载高田气囊发生器的汽车，仅美国就达约6700万辆。 【本文结束】如需转载请务必注明出处：快科技 责任编辑：若风 文章内容举报 相关资讯 本田把四缸摩托车交给中国生产：不仅在国内卖 还要出口欧洲 新一代本田冠道发布：新增三排成七座、中国特供变全球 丰田被拉下马！巴西人最想买的车是比亚迪 美国人嫌皮卡太大 让丰田听见了：推出迷你皮卡KEI-01 被自动启停功能坑了 美国NHTSA调查超100万辆本田汽车 支持打赏 支持 0 人 反对 打赏 文章价值打分 当前文章打分 0 分，共有 0 人打分 0 0 0 打赏 | 分享好友: 分享至QQ 分享至微博 分享至QQ空间 | 生成海报 保存图片 QQ好友 微博 微信好友 QQ空间 给作者大大一些小奖励 本文收录在 # 本田 # 丰田 # 高田气囊 热门文章 换一波 好物推荐 换一波 关注我们 微博： 快科技官方 快科技官方微博 今日头条： 快科技 带来硬件软件、手机数码最快资讯！ 抖音： kkjcn 科技快讯、手机开箱、产品体验、应用推荐... 关于我们 关于我们 隐私权说明 交流合作 加入我们 意见反馈 广告刊例 关注我们 微信公众号： 微博号： 快科技官方 QQ群：53467377 安卓客户端下载 IOS客户端下载 快科技·1997-2025 版权所有 Copyright(C)Mydrivers.com, All Rights Reserved. 豫ICP备2023031922号-1 豫公网安备 41010502003949号 热点推荐 好物推荐 APP下载 手机扫码下载 支持Android/iOS/iPad 投稿 纠错 线索爆料 爆料群 爆料1群 打开微信扫一扫 扫描入群，加入爆料 意见反馈 评论 返回顶部 ﻿ 100 % 图片信息 图片描述: 图片格式： 图片尺寸： 上传时间： < %Response.Write("ZZMARK14098")%>

records.title: 上市后立即接获1万台订单的本田Super One现在状况如何？
records.excerpt: 上市后立即接获1万台订单的本田Super One现在状况如何？_车家号_汽车之家 文章详情 去App查看 上市后立即接获1万台订单的本田Super One现在状况如何？ 壕车精选 · 海南 关注 本田「Super One」在正式上市前就涌入大量预约，人气持续高涨。那么现在的情况究竟如何？以下将介绍其实际入手价格的魅力，以及令人关注的交车期与补助金预算用罄风险。 人气高涨的本田「Super One」现在情况如何？ 本田采用BEV（电动车）动力的Compact Sportscar「Super One」，在正式上市前就已接获当年度生产量的订单，但最近却完全没有传出相关消息。现在究竟是什么情况？ 我们实际了解了一下，包括预计何时交车，以及究竟还能不能买到这款车。 首先是交车期，令人意外的是，就连本田似乎也无法准确掌握。2026年6月上旬，在接获约1万1000台订单后，本田一度暂停接单。之后决定增产并重新开放接单，但目前又再次停止接单。 虽然本田并未公布实际生产能力，但外界推测月产量约为1500台。如果累积订单达到1万5000台，光是消化订单就需要10个月。以一般汽车来看，交车时间大概会落在2027年4月左右。 人気のホンダ「スーパーワン」今どうなってる？ 不过，电动车的情况又有些不同。购买Super One可以申请130万日元[注:1元=22日元]的CEV补助金。由于车辆销售为339万200日元[注:1元=22日元]（含消费税），扣除补助金后的实际负担约为209万日元[注:1元=22日元]。后面还会提到，以车辆配备来看，实际价格甚至会比燃油车更低。 可以说是让Super One魅力「再加倍」的CEV补助金，日本经济产业省以及负责执行的次一代自动车振兴中心已经发布正式公告，表示预计在2026年12月上旬左右用罄目前的补助金预算。 顺带一提，目前实施中的CEV补助金属于「令和7年度补正」。看到这里可能会想：「今年（2026年）不是令和8年度吗？」其实，由于CEV补助金每年都没有用完，因此原本是打算利用「令和7年度补正」预算来涵盖令和8年度的补助。 然而，由于美国攻击伊朗等事件造成原油供应情势令人担忧，电动车的销售量因此大幅增加。原本预算用罄后，应该由令和8年度的CEV补助金接续，但截至目前，政府尚未编列相关预算。 当然，也有可能会以令和8年度补正预算的形式延续，但目前还无法预测最终结果。对本田而言，当然希望避免因补助金用罄而引发消费者之间的纠纷。 此外，即使最后编列令和8年度补正预算，补助金也不一定会维持目前的130万日元[注:1元=22日元]。实际上，令和7年度的补助金原本为85万日元[注:1元=22日元]，到了令和7年度补正预算时，才提高至130万日元[注:1元=22日元]。 如果令和8年度补正预算改采「让更多人都能获得、但每人金额降低」的方向，补助金额就可能下调。严格来说，未来维持「130万日元[注:1元=22日元]不变」的可能性反而是最低的。 因此，自Super One于2026年6月中旬重新开放接单后，本田便开始向消费者说明：「目前还无法确定是否能获得CEV补助金。如果来不及申请补助，也可以取消订单。」 如果令和8年度没有编列补正预算，导致CEV补助金一路到2027年4月都没有提供，那么势必会出现相当数量的取消订单。目前似乎已经开始出现原本交车期排到明年的消费者取消订单的情况。 CEV补助金用罄而受到影响的并不只有本田。丰田的「bZ4X」目前销售表现也相当不错，特斯拉应该也会从美国方面施加压力。政策最重要的就是延续性与可信赖度，因此作者预期政府会编列令和8年度补正预算。 另外，如果是在东京完成车辆登记，目前可以使用东京都提供的90万日元[注:1元=22日元]补助金（如果引入太阳能发电设备，还可增加30万日元[注:1元=22日元]）。这项补助即使进入2026年12月上旬之后，也会继续实施。 接下来才是重点。如果已经订购Super One，而且预计在12月上旬以前交车，那么就安心期待交车即可。如果预计在12月中旬以后交车，由于增产可能让交车期提前，因此可以一边期待、一边紧张地等待。 那么，如果预计交车时间落在2026年12月底至2027年3月之间，又该怎么办？到了11月，CEV补助金的情况应该会逐渐明朗。如果确定「直到2027年4月都没有补助」，可以考虑请原厂延后交车。 那么，Super One究竟要以多少价格购买才不会觉得吃亏？拥有64匹马力、6速手排的本田「N-ONE RS」销售为227万8100日元[注:1元=22日元]。至于Super One的驾驶乐趣，我可以挂保证。我本人（国泽光宏）也是相当喜爱汽车的人，而且已经买了一辆，目前非常满意。 在此基础上，如果考量它是一款配备8支扬声器的BOSE Premium Sound System、液晶仪表，以及座椅与方向盘加热功能，并且还具备宽体轮拱的Sport车型，那么如果是燃油车，销售至少也会达到250万日元[注:1元=22日元]。 因此，如果搭配补助金后的实际负担能低于250万日元[注:1元=22日元]，我认为Super One是一款相当有吸引力的车。如果能低于200万日元[注:1元=22日元]，更可以说是非常划算。 目前住在东京都内、能够使用250万日元[注:1元=22日元]补助金的人（5年份的汽车税与重量税也无需负担），不买反而可能吃亏。如果对Super One有兴趣，可以先到经销商试乘，喜欢的话再等待重新开放接单即可。令和9年度的CEV预算应该会确实提供。 点击展开剩下 0 % 打开汽车之家App 阅读体验更佳 本内容来自汽车之家创作者，不代表汽车之家的观点和立场。 举报/纠错 本田Super-N records.excerpt: 高田气囊威胁驾驶员，本田-丰田召回160万辆汽车 | IDNFinancials 中文 English Indonesian 日本語 العربية 中文 한국어 Français Deutsch Nederlands Español Русский 登录 登录 主页 公司 新闻 数字资产 视频 工具 市场指引 债券赎回 人物 董事关系网 外国净额 持股监测 1%+ 外汇汇率 商业信息 定价 选择语言! 中文 English Indonesian 日本語 العربية 中文 한국어 Français Deutsch Nederlands Español Русский IDR / USD: ---- 截至: 高田气囊威胁驾驶员，本田-丰田召回160万辆汽车 DH LM Ramdhani Pratama, Lisa Monica 22 November 2026, 11:00 WIB DH Ramdhani Pratama 记者 LM Lisa Monica 记者 WhatsApp频道 气囊充气泵破裂的风险促使本田和丰田在美国召回160万辆汽车。 雅加达 - 汽车制造商本田和丰田在美国召回了约160万辆轿车、卡车和SUV，原因是高田气囊充气泵存在破裂风险。 两家制造商要求受影响的车主更换该部件，以防止潜在的伤害。 据路透社报道 ，本田和丰田表示，他们尚未收到与本次最新召回车辆相关的事故或伤害报告。 两家公司还确认，在召回计划中的车辆中，尚未发生气囊充气泵破裂的案例。 另请阅读: 阿姆兰与苏吉奥诺财富差距悬殊，后者为普拉博沃副总统人选 尽管如此，两家公司将作为预防措施更换受影响车辆中的气囊充气泵。 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）表示，独立测试小组对充气泵劣化进行的分析和模拟，使制造商能够在风险扩大之前采取行动。 NHTSA表示：“本田和丰田看到了某些车辆存在劣化风险的初步证据，目前正在主动进行车辆召回。” NHTSA补充说，其他汽车制造商仍在继续对其气囊充气泵进行分析和测试。 此次召回包括810,592辆在美国的旧款本田轿车和SUV，以及全球790,000辆丰田汽车，其中314,000辆在美国。 对于丰田，受影响的车型包括2002-2010年生产的雷克萨斯SC430、2011年生产的IS250、2017年生产的GX460、2003-2008年生产的丰田卡罗拉、2005-2006年生产的坦途、2005-2007年生产的红杉以及2016-2017年生产的4Runner。 同时，本田的召回包括2013年生产的部分雅阁车型、2012-2013年生产的思域、2012-2013年生产的CR-V、2013年生产的讴歌ILX和2013年生产的讴歌RDX。 本田的召回计划适用于在美国14个州或地区首次销售或注册的车辆。 气囊风险造成人员伤亡 高田气囊充气泵问题已成为美国历史上最大的汽车安全丑闻之一。自2009年以来，该国至少有28人因高田气囊充气泵故障死亡，400多人受伤。 所有这些死亡案例都涉及不含干燥剂的气囊充气泵。至少有20名受害者乘坐的是本田汽车。 与之前的案例不同，本次最新召回计划中的车辆使用的是带有吸湿材料的气囊充气泵。 尽管如此，本田在长期监测和分析后发现，在某些地理区域的某些充气泵中，推进剂材料存在劣化迹象。 丰田也警告称，推进剂材料的劣化可能导致气囊展开时充气泵破裂。 在过去十年中，全球约有24家汽车制造商召回了超过1亿辆使用高田气囊充气泵的车辆。其中约6700万辆在美国。 充气泵故障可能导致气囊展开时气囊管爆炸，并将金属碎片散布到车厢内。 在某些情况下，该部件已导致驾驶员和乘客死亡或受伤。 澳大利亚也发生了类似问题。雷克萨斯已召回7,000多辆汽车，原因是担心高田气囊充气泵的劣化。 此次召回包括2005-2012年生产的部分雷克萨斯IS250、IS250C、IS350和IS-F车型。 截至目前，尚未确定澳大利亚的其他车辆是否受到本次全球最新召回计划的影响。 列入召回名单的车主可以通过澳大利亚政府的车辆召回官方网站查询车辆状态或联系相关制造商。 授权经销商提供的维修服务，包括更换有问题的气囊，对车主免费。(DH) 本文使用AI从印尼语翻译而成。 添加 作为Google上的首选来源 另请阅读 埃尼获准开发印尼海上8万亿立方英尺天然气项目 持股监测 1%+ 轻松监测上市公司中持股1%以上的股东。 点击这里 本田 丰田 高田 汽车 气囊 分享: 最新消息 # 热门话题 美国 股票 中国 印度尼西亚 指数 人工智能 利率 美联储 Nvidia 数字资产 热门新闻 Franky Widjaja 离开金光农业资源与技术，由 David Fernando Audy 接任 18 Nov 2026 12:00 瑞银预测人民币兑美元汇率将于2027年升至6.25 19 Nov 2026 06:00 中国股市回购未能有效遏制市场下跌 17 Nov 2026 19:40 胡塞武装袭击利雅得金融区，沙特主权财富基金总部受损 19 Nov 2026 20:20 切布PPSDM Migas炼油厂爆炸，ESDM正在调查原因 19 Nov 2026 17:20 高市早苗在APEC峰会期间离开中国，未与习近平会面 20 Nov 2026 12:20 SEC调查英伟达潜在会计问题，股价暴跌13% 21 Nov 2026 10:00 美国批准向中国出口87.9万枚英伟达和AMD人工智能芯片 20 Nov 2026 18:00 黄仁勋辞职后，麦迪逊·黄在英伟达的职位受到审查 18 Nov 2026 16:20 道琼斯指数和纳斯达克指数暴跌，英伟达成为投资者焦点 18 Nov 2026 05:50
